## Materials

Regal Plastic stocks high-quality materials, including acrylic, polycarbonate, HDPE, PVC, and a
variety of specialty plastics, ideal for industrial, commercial, and custom fabrication needs.

[Example of Lexan Glazing]

### See Thru

Lexan and Acrylic see-thru materials provide strength, clarity, and versatility. Ideal for
protective barriers, windows, and displays, these materials combine transparency with durability.
Lexan offers impact resistance for high-stress applications, while Acrylic provides excellent
clarity and UV resistance.

[Nylon Gear]

### Mechanical

Our range of mechanical plastics, including Acetal and Nylon, offers high-performance solutions for
wear-resistant and load-bearing applications. Known for their strength, low friction, and excellent
dimensional stability, these materials are ideal for parts like gears, bushings, and bearings.

[Cutting Boards]

### Industrial

Our industrial plastics range, featuring HDPE, UHMW, and LDPE, delivers chemical resistance, impact
strength, and durability. Designed for demanding applications, they excel in manufacturing,
agriculture, and construction.

[PVC-banner-material_edited_edited.jpg]

### Display

We offer a comprehensive range of display graphic substrates designed to meet the needs of the
signage, printing, and exhibit industries. Our high-quality plastic materials provide exceptional
printability, durability, and versatility, making them ideal for indoor and outdoor applications.

[Stiles-Holzma-HPP 130_edited.jpg]

## Our Services
* Cut-to-Size Plastics
* Plastic Routing, Machining & Fabrication
* Film Conversion
* Quality Control Programs

## The Art of Visual Blending

Whisk isn't just another image generator. It's a creative synthesizer that takes your specific
subject, places it in your chosen scene, and renders it in your preferred artistic style - offering
control that text prompts can't match.

### Artistic Style Enhancement

Whisk AI intuitively identifies your artistic vision and elevates your creative prompts to bring
them to life.

### Visual Composition

Learn the art of guiding AI to craft perfectly balanced, eye-catching compositions through strategic
prompt design.

### Atmospheric Elements

See how specifying lighting details, mood elements, and atmospheric qualities can produce images
that genuinely stir emotions.

### Three Input Blending

Revolutionary approach to AI image generation by combining subject, scene, and style inputs for
unprecedented control.

## Why Creators Choose Whisk

Break free from the limitations of text-only prompting. Whisk gives you the visual vocabulary to
express exactly what's in your mind.

Infinite Possibilities
Precise Creative Control
Rapid Visual Iteration

## Materials

Regal Plastic stocks high-quality materials, including acrylic, polycarbonate, HDPE, PVC, and a
variety of specialty plastics, ideal for industrial, commercial, and custom fabrication needs.

[Example of Lexan Glazing]

### See Thru

Lexan and Acrylic see-thru materials provide strength, clarity, and versatility. Ideal for
protective barriers, windows, and displays, these materials combine transparency with durability.
Lexan offers impact resistance for high-stress applications, while Acrylic provides excellent
clarity and UV resistance.

[Nylon Gear]

### Mechanical

Our range of mechanical plastics, including Acetal and Nylon, offers high-performance solutions for
wear-resistant and load-bearing applications. Known for their strength, low friction, and excellent
dimensional stability, these materials are ideal for parts like gears, bushings, and bearings.

[Cutting Boards]

### Industrial

Our industrial plastics range, featuring HDPE, UHMW, and LDPE, delivers chemical resistance, impact
strength, and durability. Designed for demanding applications, they excel in manufacturing,
agriculture, and construction.

[PVC-banner-material_edited_edited.jpg]

### Display

We offer a comprehensive range of display graphic substrates designed to meet the needs of the
signage, printing, and exhibit industries. Our high-quality plastic materials provide exceptional
printability, durability, and versatility, making them ideal for indoor and outdoor applications.

[Stiles-Holzma-HPP 130_edited.jpg]

## Our Services
* Cut-to-Size Plastics
* Plastic Routing, Machining & Fabrication
* Film Conversion
* Quality Control Programs

# **Trusted for Quality. Chosen for Speed.**

Akrylix turns concepts into reality — fast. Custom fabrication, scalable production, and reliable
delivery, even on the tightest timelines.

[Start Your Project][22]

##### what we do

# Our Services

From eye-catching retail displays to time-critical trade show builds, Akrylix delivers high-quality
acrylic solutions — fast.

Explore our most requested services below.

##### **POP & Retail Displays**

Custom acrylic displays engineered for retail impact — seasonal promos, product showcases, and
high-volume rollouts.

##### **Trade Show & Event Solutions**

Portable, durable, and custom-fit acrylic components for booths, exhibits, and branded installations
— built to impress and travel well.

##### **Rush & Specialty Projects**

Tight deadline? Unique specs? We specialize in fast-turn, one-off, and technically complex projects
that others can’t take on.

###### About us

## **Reliable. Responsive. Ready for Any Acrylic Project.**

At Akrylix, we specialize in delivering high-quality acrylic solutions — whether you need a one-off
prototype, a rush trade show display, or a long-term production partner — all made in the USA. Our
team combines speed, precision, and flexibility to meet your timeline and exceed expectations. If
it’s made from acrylic, we can make it — and deliver it fast.

###### working with us

# why choose us

##### **Fast Turnarounds Without Sacrificing Quality**

We specialize in hitting tight deadlines while maintaining the high standards your brand demands —
from one-off displays to full production runs.

[Explore Our Capabilities][23]

##### **Built Around Your Project — Not the Other Way Around**

Whether you’re starting with a sketch, a CAD file, or just an idea, we tailor the entire process to
your needs — from design to delivery.

[Who We Serve][24]

Founded in the year ***2000***, **Laser Craft India** has a long tradition of excellence and are an
undisputed leader in the domain of gifting and award items. We have not only captured a vast amount
of market share but have also acquired a distinguished position of noted **manufacturer, importer

professionals and reliable vendor base, we are able to supply a peerless spectrum of products such
as** Acrylic Trophies, Customized Acrylic Trophies, Metal Trophies, etc.** Besides, our ability to
offer effective packaging solutions adds to our competency in this regard.

Throughout the years, we have built our stance by offering strong, dependable and economical
personalized & corporate gifting options for a wide range of corporate sectors. To ensure that our
client requirements are met at all levels, we have collated a highly skilled team of professionals
to assist us in our activities. Their profound understanding of the business coupled with market
knowledge have helped us in getting associated with a reliable network of clients in the industry.

timely delivery of consignments.

To serve our clients with the best quality products, we have appointed a vigil team of quality
controllers who manage quality from end to end. They conduct market research and procure products
only after rigorous assessment and quality testing procedures. Constant market research by our
quality agents helps us to analyze and deliver a satisfactory experience to the customers. We take
care of our customer satisfaction through:
* Quality of our offerings
* Cost effectiveness
* Timely delivery of orders
* Customer integrated work strategies
* Advantageous business deals

Laser Craft India blessed to have an infrastructural facility which is highly reliable for heavy
production of a diversified product range including **Acrylic Trophies, Metal Trophies, Customized
Acrylic Trophies, **etc. Under the roof of our advanced infrastructure, we are acquiring all
essential sound facilities that help our working employees to conveniently pull out a high quality
range within shortest time.

**Product Designing, Customization & Delivery **

We are a responsible manufacturer of a diversified product range. Our main aim is to generate and
serve a quality of product which is easy to rely upon, value for putting on and resourceful for the
users. Therefore, our experts design the product as per industrial standards as well as the
specified demands of our customers. The customization is available for the customers who have ideas
or special requirements. Besides that, we also ensure that our offered items are delivered to the
required location within promised timeline.

**Clientele/Industry We Cater To**

For years, our network base has been expanding constantly. We are retaining our previously existing
clients, while responsibly fulfilling the growing demands of newer clients. The industries we cater
to are:
* IIPM
* NSIT
* CRPF
* Delhi Public School
* Unicef
* IIT, Delhi & Roorkee
* General Motor

**Team**

Being a team of professionals, we acquire all worthy skills that are necessary for sustaining a
never ending growth in the sector. The team of ours is containing designing experts, technicians,
marketing heads, etc. Each department works in synchronization, with complete transparency &
responsibility so that, no compromise is made in any manner.

**Why Us?**
* For availing personalized solution by our professed experts.
* For availing standard as well as customized products at the best prices.
* For availing a unique and satisfactory experience every single time.
* For making easy payments as per your convenience.

Our Workshop

Based in Dongguan, Guangdong, we are a premier manufacturer specializing in high-precision acrylic
fabrication since 2012. Over the past decade, we have established ourselves as a strategic partner
for businesses worldwide, transforming complex design concepts into high-quality, bespoke acrylic
solutions. From custom retail displays and exhibition stands to personalized acrylic blocks and
furniture, our facility is engineered to handle projects of all scales with professional precision.
We are deeply experienced in managing international logistics, ensuring that your bespoke products
arrive securely and on schedule in the United States, Europe, Australia, and beyond.

**Comprehensive Acrylic Fabrication & Custom Solutions**

Our Dongguan facility features a comprehensive, state-of-the-art production line designed for
high-precision acrylic fabrication. By integrating advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship,
we ensure that every project—from simple displays to complex bespoke structures—meets the highest
industry standards. Our core capabilities include:

**Precision Cutting & Milling**: We utilize advanced laser cutting machines for intricate,
clean-edged designs and CNC machining centers to achieve complex shapes with high dimensional
accuracy.

**Professional Polishing**: We employ a variety of finishing techniques to ensure crystal clarity,
including diamond polishing machines for a superior edge, buffer wheel polishing machines for a
refined finish, and flame polishing machines for quick, high-gloss results.

**Custom Graphics & Branding**: Our facility is equipped with high-resolution UV printing machines
for vibrant, full-color designs and screen printing (silkscreen) equipment for durable, professional
logo and graphic application.

**Handcrafted Excellence**: Most of our display racks and acrylic boxes are meticulously assembled
and finished by skilled artisans, ensuring a premium aesthetic that mass-produced items cannot
match.

**Scalable OEM/ODM Solutions**: From raw material processing to final assembly, our streamlined
workflow maintains consistent quality and competitive pricing, allowing us to support both
small-batch prototypes and large-scale production runs without requiring high tooling costs.

**Partner With Us**

We are ready to support your next project with professional OEM/ODM manufacturing services. To
receive a prompt and accurate quote, please send us your detailed specifications, dimensions, and
quantity requirements. Our team looks forward to helping you achieve your goals with high-quality,
tailor-made acrylic solutions.

# PNG Transparency Creator

This free tool lets you make any image background transparent. Upload a PNG or JPG image, pick the
background color to remove, adjust threshold and smoothing, and download your transparent PNG
instantly. Works entirely in your browser – no uploads needed.

## About PNG Transparency Creator

Ever needed to remove the background from an image but didn’t know where to start? Yeah, same here.
A lot of times it sounds easy — like “just remove the background” — but when you actually sit down
to do it, it’s a whole mess of complicated tools, expensive software, or confusing online websites.

That’s exactly why we built **PNG Transparency Creator** — a simple tool that lets you make any PNG
image transparent, right inside your browser. No downloads. No installations. Just upload your
image, pick the background color (or colors) you want gone, adjust a slider or two, and poof —
background removed.

### Why You Might Need This Tool

Transparent PNGs are everywhere. Ever notice how logos on websites don’t have weird white boxes
behind them? That’s because they use transparent images.

A transparent image means you can use it on:
* Websites
* YouTube thumbnails
* Social media posts
* Memes (of course)
* Business presentations
* Online shops and product listings

If your image still has a colored background, it sticks out like a sore thumb on a fancy webpage.
Transparent PNG solves that.

### How Does This PNG Transparency Tool Work?

Honestly, it’s super simple. Here’s the magic:
1. Upload your image on the left panel.
2. Click the background color you want to remove — like white, gray, green, whatever it is.
3. Adjust the **Threshold** slider to control how aggressive it should be. Low threshold = precise
   removal. Higher = removes more shades.
4. Turn on **Smooth Edges** if the edges look rough.
5. You can also enable **Blur** instead of full removal.
6. Download your transparent PNG from the right panel. Boom. Done.

It all happens **right in your browser.** No servers. Your image doesn’t get uploaded anywhere.

### Is It Really Free?

Kind of. Sort of. Mostly. But not totally.

**Free users** get **10 queries per PNG tool per day** for **personal use only** — meaning stuff
like personal projects, school, social media, memes, hobbies, and non-commercial tasks.

But if you need more than that — like unlimited queries and **commercial use rights** — you’ll want
to upgrade to **Premium**.

Premium gives you:
* 🔓 **Unlimited queries per day**
* ⚡ **Priority processing**
* 🚀 **Commercial usage license**
* 🎯 **Access to all PNG tools without limits**

### Why Use This Instead of Photoshop or Other Sites?
* ✔️ **No Downloads:** Works in any browser — Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari. Nothing to install.
* ✔️ **Privacy First:** Your images never leave your computer. We don’t upload your files.
* ✔️ **Ridiculously Simple:** Upload, click, adjust, download.
* ✔️ **No Ads, No Spam:** The free version has limits, but no annoying popups or watermarks.
* ✔️ **Super Fast:** Runs locally in your browser.
* ✔️ **Multiple Color Removal:** Remove multiple background colors at once.
* ✔️ **Undo / Redo:** Easily go back if you make a mistake.
* ✔️ **Blur Option:** Blur background instead of removing it completely.

### Nerdier Features (If You Like That Stuff)
* **Threshold Control:** More precise color range detection.
* **Smooth Edges:** Soften rough edges.
* **Blur Background:** Keep background but make it soft.
* **Checkerboard Canvas:** Shows transparency clearly.
* **Download ZIP:** Includes both original and transparent PNG.

### Is It Safe?

Yup. 100%. Everything happens in your browser. We don’t upload your files. We don’t store anything.
What happens on your computer… stays on your computer.

### Who Should Use This?
* ⭐ Students (for school or projects)
* ⭐ Bloggers and website owners
* ⭐ YouTubers and content creators
* ⭐ eCommerce sellers (remove backgrounds from product photos)
* ⭐ Meme makers
* ⭐ Graphic design newbies
* ⭐ Businesses (with Premium for commercial use)

### Real-World Example

Imagine you’ve got a product photo of a coffee mug on a white background. You upload it, click the
white background, adjust threshold to clean up shadows, enable **Smooth Edges**, and download.

In less than 20 seconds, you’ve got a mug image with a transparent background. Ready to use on any
website or poster.

### Limitations (Being Honest Here)
* Works best with solid color backgrounds or clear separations.
* Not AI-powered (yet). It’s simple color matching, not object detection.
* Large images may lag depending on your browser and device.
* Free usage capped at **10 queries per tool per day**. Unlimited and commercial use needs Premium.

# **Welcome to Collins Plastics**

Established in 1982 and owned by Liam Collins, Collins Plastics design and fabricate a wide range of
plastic sheet products including display stands, brochure & window displays, collection boxes, menu
holders, signs, shop displays, machine guards etc.

We also provide specialised custom services for unique items where required. Located in purpose
built premises in Ballina, Co. Mayo, we offer a complete nationwide service from concept to the
finished project.

Products can be manufactured in a variety of materials including Acrylic, Foamex, PVC,
Polypropylene, Perspex, Lexan, Darvic, etc. The company policy of investment in the most modern
machinery available and staff training has led to the highest standard of workmanship.

After over 30 years in business, we have built a reputation for working as a partner with other
companies, and pride ourselves on developing new designs to suit various requirements.

Our Workshop

Based in Dongguan, Guangdong, we are a premier manufacturer specializing in high-precision acrylic
fabrication since 2012. Over the past decade, we have established ourselves as a strategic partner

**Comprehensive Acrylic Fabrication & Custom Solutions**

Our Dongguan facility features a comprehensive, state-of-the-art production line designed for
high-precision acrylic fabrication. By integrating advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship,
we ensure that every project—from simple displays to complex bespoke structures—meets the highest
industry standards. Our core capabilities include:

clean-edged designs and CNC machining centers to achieve complex shapes with high dimensional
accuracy.

**Professional Polishing**: We employ a variety of finishing techniques to ensure crystal clarity,
including diamond polishing machines for a superior edge, buffer wheel polishing machines for a
refined finish, and flame polishing machines for quick, high-gloss results.

**Custom Graphics & Branding**: Our facility is equipped with high-resolution UV printing machines
for vibrant, full-color designs and screen printing (silkscreen) equipment for durable, professional
logo and graphic application.

**Handcrafted Excellence**: Most of our display racks and acrylic boxes are meticulously assembled

**Scalable OEM/ODM Solutions**: From raw material processing to final assembly, our streamlined
